d1m1-open.subject: New matter: John Doe — MVA 02/06/2026 (passenger)
d1m1-open.body: New file for LSH Law Group: John Doe, front-seat passenger, collision 02/06/2026 at Maple Hollow Rd and Birch Ave. Attached: the New Client Intake Sheet, intake supplement, the retainer and HIPAA authorization he signed here this morning, and the Riverton PD crash report. A colleague keyed a draft intake record into the CMS. Atty. Thorne wants the matter active today.

d1m3-a1.subject: Voicemail: John Doe — call from the other driver's insurance
d1m3-a1.body: Hey, it's John Doe. I signed with Mr. Thorne yesterday. Last night Dana from Keystone Mutual, the other guy's insurance, asked what happened and if she could record it. I said I'd think about it; she's calling back today. I haven't gotten anything from you guys. My neck's still stiff. I'm at work, so call my cell: 555-010-2288.
d1m3-a1.spoken: Hey, uh... this is John Doe. I signed with Mr. Thorne yesterday, for the car accident. So, last night, somebody from Keystone Mutual called me. That's the other guy's insurance. A lady... Dana, I think. She was asking what happened, and if she could record it. I didn't know what to tell her, so I said I'd think about it, and she said she'd call me back today. And, um, I haven't gotten anything from you guys yet. No paperwork, nothing. My neck's still stiff. It's worse in the morning. Can you call me back? I'm calling from work, but call my cell. It's five five five, oh one oh, two two eight eight. Okay. Thanks. Bye.

listen.q: Who left the message, and which number does he want you to call back?
listen.a: John Doe, on his cell: (555) 010-2288. The caller ID is his work line at Northgate, not the number to call.

listen.q: Who contacted him, and what did they ask for?
listen.a: Dana, from Keystone Mutual (the other driver's insurance): what happened, and to record it.

listen.q: What did he tell her, and when will she try again?
listen.a: He said he'd think about it, and she said she'd call him back today.
His neck is still stiff, and it's worse in the morning.

listen.q: What hasn't he received from the firm?
listen.a: Anything at all yet: no paperwork from the firm.

d1m3-a2.body: LSH-2026-MVA-770412. John Doe's Direction Packet was delivered and logged 02/10/2026. Its directions are staged as draft task cards; a card cannot activate without an owner, a due date and a verification method. No treatment start is recorded, and no follow-up is on the calendar.

d2m1-a1.body: Claims are open: Keystone BI KM-26-440871 (Dana Whitfield) and PD (Leah Moran, who accepted PD liability this morning), Harbor Point HP-26-7741 (Marcus Bell, Host UM and PIP), Cardinal State CS-26-20355, no adjuster yet. I want the three LORs, plus notices to Bluewater and Peach State, on my desk for signature today. Preferred delivery methods are in the Communications Log.

Limits were reported by phone; none is confirmed in writing. The Insurance tab has no layers, so today's letter set cannot merge carrier details until it does.

d1m4-a1.subject: Records indexed: Riverton Urgent Care and first Riverton Spine & Rehab visits
d1m4-a1.body: LSH-2026-MVA-770412. Riverton Urgent Care's 02/20/2026 note and Riverton Spine & Rehab's visits since 02/24/2026 are indexed to the treatment timeline beside the 02/06/2026 EMS Run Report. First treatment falls 14 days after the date of loss. Risk Flags: none recorded.

d1m4-a2.subject: Doe v. Smith: Case Plan to me today
d1m4-a2.body: I need the full Case Plan on John Doe, all five bands, routed to me by end of day: the acceptance decision and why, the stack in order with a preliminary projection, liability, the triple-check, the three pillars with owners and dates, and the risks band. Docket the filing window. If I have to ask a question, it isn't finished.

d1m2-a1.subject: No client contact: John Doe, 6 days
d1m2-a1.body: LSH-2026-MVA-770412. Last logged contact with John Doe: 02/10/2026. Check-in call scheduled 02/13/2026: missed. Phone system shows two calls to his mobile ending in voicemail, neither in the Communications Log. No treatment start recorded. Emergency contact on file: Margaret Doe, (555) 010-2291. No Contact Protocol Step 1 due today.

d1m2-a2.subject: RE: Step 3 — John Doe, no contact
d1m2-a2.body: Read your Step 3 note. Eleven days and no word from John, and no treatment that we know of. Draft the Final Warning Letter for my review Monday morning: every attempt with its date, a response date, how to reach us. Certified mail and email. Withdrawal is possible, not decided, and the letter says nothing about his claim.

d2m2-a1.subject: New patient John Doe, evaluation 02/24 — LOP needed
d2m2-a1.body: John Doe is booked for his chiropractic and PT evaluation tomorrow, 02/24. We're out of network with Peach State, so before we see him we'll need a signed Letter of Protection and your HIPAA authorization. Can you get them to me today? Tammy Greer, Office Manager

d2m3-a1.subject: John Doe: why 14 days?
d2m3-a1.body: Urgent care's 02/20 note is in: onset at the MVA, numbness to the right hand since 02/18. EMS has neck stiffness on 02/06. Nobody has asked John why he waited 14 days. Get him on a recorded call today. Open questions, nothing suggested, and no opinions on what it means. GIRP note to me when you're done.

d2m2-a2.subject: Missed-visit alert: John Doe, LOP account RSR-26-0412
d2m2-a2.body: Per your LOP dated 02/23/2026: John Doe missed 04/03 (no call) and 04/07. He told our front desk his mother's rental ended and his ride is no longer available. He's booked 04/09 and 04/14 at 4:15 PM. Our 6:00 PM evening schedule is full until the week of 04/20; he's on the wait list. Please contact your client.

d2m2-a3.subject: Voicemail: John Doe — won't go to Millbrook for the injection
d2m2-a3.body: It's John Doe. Lakeside booked my injection at Millbrook Interventional Pain Center, in Millbrook, May 14 at 9:00 a.m. I'm not going. It's way out there and I've got no ride; my car's in the shop and my mom works days. And I heard it's out of network with Peach State. I still want the shot. Call my cell.
d2m2-a3.spoken: Hey, it's John Doe... the car accident. So, uh, Lakeside called me yesterday about the shot. The injection Dr. Reyes wants me to get. They booked me at some place called Millbrook Interventional Pain Center. In Millbrook. May fourteenth, nine in the morning. And... I'm not going there. It's way out in Millbrook, my car's still in the shop, and my mom works days, so I've got no ride out there. And a guy at work said that place isn't in network with Peach State, so I'd get stuck with a bill. I still want to get the shot, okay? Just... not there. Can you help me sort it out? Call me on my cell, it's five five five, oh one oh, two two eight eight. I'm on lunch till one, then I'm on the floor till three thirty. Thanks.

listen.q: Who called, and which number does he want you to call back?
Where did Lakeside book him, and when?
listen.a: Millbrook Interventional Pain Center, in Millbrook, on May 14 at 9:00 a.m.

listen.q: What are his two reasons for not going?
listen.a: It's too far, with no ride: his mother's Civic is in the shop and his mother works days. And he heard it's out of network with Peach State.

listen.q: Does he still want the injection?
listen.a: Yes: he still wants it, just not at that facility.

listen.q: When can you reach him today?
listen.a: On his lunch until 1:00; after that he's on the floor until 3:30.

d2m3-a2.subject: Gap Explanation Record before the pre-demand session
d2m3-a2.body: Dr. Reyes's Causation Letter of 06/19 is in, and John reached MMI on 06/12. Before our pre-demand session I want the Gap Explanation Record: both interruptions with exact dates, every reason beside the dated document that proves it, “account only” where there isn't one. Facts and citations, no argument. Run your defense-eye pass first.

d2m4-a1.subject: Billing complete: Special Damages Audit due
d2m4-a1.body: LSH-2026-MVA-770412. All billing indexed: Riverton Urgent Care, Riverton Spine & Rehab (34 lines), Lakeside Orthopedics, Summit Imaging, Crescent Pain & Spine with Peach State's EOB, Riverton Drug. Northgate HR's wage-and-attendance letter (06/30/2026) received. Task “Special Damages Audit and lien list” is due before the pre-demand session.

d2m4-a2.subject: Doe v. Smith: pre-demand strategy session, 2:00 p.m. today
d2m4-a2.body: I've read your audit. Strategy session on John Doe today at 2:00 p.m., my office. Bottom line first. Expect me to push the way Keystone will: low speed, the 14 days, the “degenerative” read. Bring the facts, the documents and the operational options. The decisions on the demand are mine.

d1m3-a1.persona: Polite, tired and sore; rattled by the Keystone call. Wants plain answers. Will ask whether to talk to Keystone, whose fault it was, and what his case is worth.
d1m3-a1.context: 02/10/2026. Retainer signed 02/09; the matter is open; no onboarding packet has reached him. John, 34, a Northgate warehouse shift lead, was the front-seat passenger in coworker Kevin Alvarez's Escape on 02/06. Last night a Keystone Mutual caller asked to record his account; he said he'd think about it, and she said she'd call back. His neck is stiff; he hasn't seen anyone. Margaret's Civic was towed from the scene and he has no car. Calms with clear steps; repeats instructions back if asked.
d1m3-a1.opening: Hey, it's John Doe, returning your call. So the other guy's insurance called me last night, a lady from Keystone, wanting to record what happened. She said she'd call back. What do I tell her?
goals: Route all Keystone contact to the firm; no Recorded Statement
Confirm he understood by having him repeat the instruction
State the packet's treatment direction, since treatment hasn't begun
Confirm Property Damage details and the packet's delivery method
d1m3-a1.line: Give the firm's instructions only; fault, claim value and legal effect go to Atty. Thorne.

d2m1-a2.persona: Seasoned BI adjuster, brisk and guarded. Considers the limit question answered. Fishes for treatment details and a demand number; commits to nothing in writing without being pinned.
d2m1-a2.context: 03/11/2026. Keystone BI claim KM-26-440871, insured Robert Smith, policy KMI-PA-7731045, DOL 02/06/2026. She gave the $10,000 per-person limit by phone at set-up, and her 02/24/2026 letter promised the declarations page once the firm's written request and signed authorizations arrived. They have been sent; nothing has come back. She says it is with underwriting. Asked for a specific date, she commits to sending it by 03/20/2026. She asks how John is treating and what the firm will demand.
d2m1-a2.opening: Dana Whitfield. I've got about five minutes. If this is the Dec Page again, I gave your office the limit on the first call. Ten thousand per person. What else do you need?
goals: Confirm Keystone received the written request and signed authorizations
Get a firm date for the Declaration Page in writing
Share no treatment detail or demand figure
Log the call and set the next follow-up by 03/13/2026
d2m1-a2.line: Verify coverage only: no demand figure, liability argument or treatment detail without Atty. Thorne's approval.

d1m2-a1.persona: Warm, protective mother, wary of a law office calling. Worried about John. Will ask what is going on with his case and whether her own insurance is involved.
d1m2-a1.context: 02/16/2026. Margaret Doe, John's mother, is the emergency contact collected at intake; John lives with her at 2214 Maple Hollow Rd. The firm has not reached John since 02/10: a missed check-in call and two voicemails. He called out of work last week with his neck and has been texting her about the pain; as far as she knows he hasn't seen a doctor. She doesn't know why he hasn't called back. Her Cardinal State policy is on the file. She'll pass a message.
d1m2-a1.opening: Hello? This is Margaret. You said you're with a law office, calling about John? Is he all right? He's not in some kind of trouble, is he?
goals: Identify yourself and confirm she is the emergency contact on file
Ask her to have John call the firm by a set date
Confirm John's best phone number and current address
Disclose no case details; log date, time, channel and outcome
d1m2-a1.line: Share nothing about John's case and no advice on her policy; refer her questions to Atty. Thorne.

d2m2-a2.persona: Embarrassed and frustrated; short answers at first. In pain and defensive about the missed visits. Will ask if this ruins his case. Opens up when not judged.
d2m2-a2.context: 04/08/2026. Riverton Spine & Rehab reports John missed 04/03 and 04/07; last visit 04/02. Keystone ended Margaret's rental on 03/19 at its 30-day cap; Margaret's Civic is still waiting on parts; Kevin Alvarez's shift changed 04/01, ending the carpool. He has no ride to his 4:15 PM appointments. His neck and right arm still bother him. His mother Margaret works a day shift and could drive him in the evenings, but he only says so if asked who could help.
d2m2-a2.opening: Yeah, I know, I missed a couple. I'm not blowing it off, I swear. I just don't have a way to get there anymore. Is this going to mess up my case?
goals: Find the barrier and ask about his current symptoms
Build a transport plan from the options, saying why
Book evening slots with the clinic while John is on the line
No treatment advice and nothing on what missed visits mean
d2m2-a2.line: No advice to add, skip or stop care; questions about his claim go to Atty. Thorne.

d2m3-a1.persona: Guarded and expecting blame for the delay. Clipped answers to yes-or-no questions; talks freely to open ones. Agrees with any reason suggested to him. Asks if the gap hurts.
d2m3-a1.context: 03/04/2026, recorded call. John first treated 02/20/2026, 14 days after the collision. Asked openly, he gives four reasons in his own words: no car (Civic towed, Kevin's Escape in the shop, no rental until 02/18); thought it was soreness, took ibuprofen and lidocaine patches; unsure his new Peach State plan was active, never heard of PIP; right-hand numbness from 02/18, worked 02/18–02/19, went in on his first day off. He texted his mother about it 02/07–02/15, called out of work 02/09–02/13, kept the 02/07 pharmacy receipt.
d2m3-a1.opening: Hey, it's John. I'm on my break, sitting in the rental, so I've got about twenty minutes. What did you need to go over?
goals: Open on record: date, parties, role, his consent, privacy confirmed
Draw out all four reasons with open, non-leading questions
Ask for the paper: the texts, the call-outs, the 02/07 receipt
Read back his account; confirm 03/05 consult and post-03/19 transport
d2m3-a1.line: Never suggest a reason, interpret it or say what the gap does to his case; route that to Atty. Thorne.

d2m4-a2.persona: Exacting senior trial lawyer, short on time. Plays the adjuster to test you. Wants facts, not adjectives; bristles at any valuation from staff.
d2m4-a2.context: 07/08/2026, before any demand. MMI 06/12; Specials $16,401.40 ($14,817.40 medical after the 05/04 duplicate came out, plus $1,584.00 wages); liens $1,860.00 Peach State and $6,105.00 LOP; targets $10,000 BI, $20,000 Host UM, $10,000 Relative UM. He pushes: low-speed impact, the 14-day gap, the “degenerative” MRI, and asks what the case is worth. Briefed well, he decides: a time-limited BI demand served 07/20/2026, the gap addressed up front, no UM demand before a documented BI tender, billed-vs-paid his call.
d2m4-a2.opening: I've got twenty minutes. Bottom line first. Then tell me why Keystone shouldn't call this a low-speed bump with a guy who waited two weeks to see a doctor.
goals: Lead with the bottom line: MMI, $16,401.40 Specials, $10,000 BI limit
Meet each challenge with dated documents, not adjectives
Get his decisions: demand, the gap, UM consents, billed-vs-paid
Read back each decision; task it with an owner and date
d2m4-a2.line: Recommend operations only; propose no demand figure and leave every legal decision to Atty. Thorne.

event.subject: Letter merge blocked: client role reads “Driver”
event.body: The Harbor Point and Cardinal State LORs will not generate: the matter record still lists John Doe as the driver. A driver listing points at the wrong coverage. Correct it from the Police Report before today's letters go.

event.subject: RE: KM-26-440871 — your client's statement
event.body: For your file: before your letter reached us, Mr. Doe told our caller on 02/11 that he “felt fine, just sore” and had no plans to see a doctor. That is in our claim notes and will be weighed against the treatment you are presenting.

event.subject: Case Plan returned: coverage band
event.body: Your coverage band carries $40,000 with no source for any limit and no “preliminary” mark. I can't set strategy on numbers I can't trace. Put the document and date behind each limit, mark the projection preliminary where one is missing, and route it again.

event.subject: Calendar audit: no statute of limitations docketed
event.body: Step 1 review cannot list live deadlines: LSH-2026-MVA-770412 has no SOL on the calendar and two roles still read “unknown”. SOL 02/06/2028 must be docketed with reminders before outreach continues; the gap is reported to Atty. Thorne.

event.subject: Task audit: no treatment-start follow-up
event.body: No task tracks whether John Doe has started treatment. His silence since 02/10/2026 surfaced only through today's no-contact flag, and six days have run with no provider, no first visit and no date to check against.

event.subject: Treatment risk missed: rental end never calendared
event.body: The rental's 03/19/2026 end date was recorded in John Doe's assessment but never calendared as a treatment risk. He lost his transport three weeks ago with no plan in place, and the firm is learning of it from the clinic's missed-visit alert.

event.subject: Gap record: corroboration never requested
event.body: No tasks exist for John Doe's texts to his mother, the 02/07/2026 Riverton Drug receipt or Northgate's call-out records. Those gap reasons stand as “account only” until the documents are chased, with the pre-demand session days away.

event.subject: Lien Tracker: Peach State missing from the pre-demand list
event.body: The pre-demand lien list pulls only dated, flagged liens. Peach State's $1,860.00 reimbursement claim, asserted 02/27/2026, never got a dated flag and is missing. The Net Sheet projection overstates John Doe's share by $1,860.00 until the record is fixed.
